description: Convert text offsets between UTF-16, code points, UTF-8 bytes and graphemes, and locate hidden Unicode — Reports the length of a string in UTF-16 code units, Unicode code points, UTF-8 bytes and extended grapheme clusters (Intl.Segmenter), converts up to 200 ranges given in any one of those units into all four, and flags ranges that fall inside a surrogate pair, a multi-byte UTF-8 character or a grapheme cluster. It also runs the unicode-check rules (bidi controls, zero-width and invisible characters

kind.description: How the unicode rules treat the string. Default text.

ranges.description: Half-open ranges to convert; each is read in its own unit.

scan.description: Run the hidden-Unicode rules. Default true.

name: text-offsets
